examples.translated: Every time I enter a pastry shop I stuff myself with cookies.

examples.original: Me queda harto por hacer.
examples.translated: I have a lot left to do.

examples.original: Vamos a hacer un estofado para la cena de la próxima semana. - Está bien, pero háganlo con pollo que recuerden que yo no como carne roja.
examples.translated: We're going to make a stew for the dinner next week. - That's fine, but make it with chicken because remember that I don't eat red meat.

examples.original: Estamos pensando en votar por el candidato independiente. - Háganlo. Es un país libre.
examples.translated: We're thinking of voting for the independent candidate. - Do it. It's a free country.

examples.translated: We want to go get more lobster. - Go for it. It's a wedding, no one's going to judge you.

examples.original: ¿Podemos decirle a la gente que estás embarazada, o no lo quieres anunciar todavía? - Claro, háganlo.

examples.translated: He told me to wash the dishes but I had already done it.

examples.original: Hizo una nueva amiga en el colegio.
examples.translated: He made a new friend at school.

examples.translated: I thought there was nobody at home.

examples.original: El dolor hizo mi vida miserable.
examples.translated: The pain made my life a misery.

examples.original: Ese peinado te hace más vieja.
examples.translated: That hairstyle makes you look older.

examples.original: ¡No hagas el mono en el colegio!
examples.translated: Don't act the fool at school!

examples.original: Se dice que el doctor hace hasta seis cifras.
examples.translated: They say the doctor makes at least six figures.

examples.original: Mi hermanito hizo una fortuna vendiendo limonada.
examples.translated: My little brother earned a fortune selling lemonade.

examples.original: Les hizo dos semanas manejar a California.
examples.translated: It took them two weeks to drive to California.

examples.original: Hicimos 150 millas en el último viaje.
examples.translated: We did 150 miles on the last vacation.

examples.original: Podemos hacer más distancia si salimos de noche.
examples.translated: We can cover more distance if we leave at night.

examples.original: Hace mucho tiempo que no te veo.
examples.translated: It has been a long time since I've seen you.

examples.original: En invierno hace frío.
examples.translated: It's cold in winter.

examples.original: Se hizo un vestido de seda.
examples.translated: She made herself a silk dress.

examples.original: Creo que voy a hacerme un puré de zanahorias esta noche.
examples.translated: I think I'm going to make myself some carrot soup tonight.

examples.original: No te hagas el santo; tú también te equivocas.
examples.translated: Don't pretend to be a saint; you make mistakes, too.

examples.original: No te hagas el tonto conmigo.
examples.translated: Don't act the fool with me.

examples.original: Su sueño era hacerse dentista.
examples.translated: His dream was to become a dentist.
